title: Amazon API Gateway to AWS Lambda to Amazon Translate
description: Perform language translation using Translate through Lambda and API Gateway

introBox.headline: How it works
text: Use Amazon API Gateway, AWS Lambda, and Amazon Translate to perform language translation without managing servers.
See the GitHub repo for detailed testing instructions.

authors.name: Arjun Arippa
authors.bio: Arjun Arippa is a Solutions Architect based in Bangalore, India. He works with some of the strategic and global customers in India, to build and architect their applications on AWS. Before joining AWS, Arjun spent over a decade working as a Software Developer. Reach out to him on LinkedIn
